overall_comment: The imaging findings are highly suggestive of a low-grade diffuse glioma. The complete absence of enhancement or necrosis strongly favors an IDH-mutant tumor, most likely a WHO grade 2 astrocytoma given the insular and deep white matter involvement. A grade 3 astrocytoma is less likely but cannot be fully excluded. Final grade would depend on molecular analysis (e.g., CDKN2A/B status).
